discovery_shared_context: Root requested an attempted exclusion of the constant-only ternary left kernel; Structural derived this unrestricted-entry non-obstruction construction. Root has not independently verified this candidate.
statement: For every symmetric integer 99-by-99 matrix H with Hj=21j whose ternary reduction G satisfies Gj=0, G^2-G=2J and rank(G)=55, there exists a 99-by-231 matrix M over the 3-adic integers with MM^T=H, M1=7j, M^Tj=3*1 and rank_F3(M)=98. For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix with the same exact margins and rank98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues. This does not require or assert binary entries, nonnegative entries, triangle supports, or an ordinary integer exact-Gram factor.

scope.description: Formal unrestricted-entry ternary and 3-adic Gram-and-margin relaxation, applied conditionally to H=A+7I of a hypothetical SRG(99,14,1,2).

assumptions: H is symmetric integer 99-by-99 and Hj=21j.
Over F3, G=H mod3 satisfies Gj=0, G^2-G=2J and rank(G)=55.
The relaxed factor may have arbitrary 3-adic integer entries; at finite precision arbitrary ordinary integer entries are allowed.
failed_argument: The target ternary Gram, incidence margins, determinant/divided-form data and perfect mod9 pairing by themselves force a left ternary dependency outside span(j). The constructed 3-adic factor retains these algebraic properties for the actual hypothetical target H while its left ternary kernel is exactly span(j); an additional incidence restriction is necessary.
method: Written symbolic construction, congruence diagonalization over F3, elementary orthogonal reflections, and coherent linear lifting. No scripts perform mathematical arithmetic.

overlap.generalization: Every prescribed target-compatible ternary Gram, exact margins, and all 3-adic precisions, rather than one special formal ternary example.
overlap.search_scope: Bounded Markdown comparison and whole reads of the six pinned derivations; no exhaustive archive or literature novelty claim.
